text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Camp finishes without a hitch, and though
it's now autumn, the
Twinkle Series is
wrapped in what feels like the heat of
midsummer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the center of that heat are the sisters
Narita Brian and Biwa
Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquers the Kikuka Sho,
beating last year's record set
by Biwa
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Before you is the fifth ever Triple Crown
champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The younger sister crushes the Japanese Derby, so the elder breaks the record for the Takarazuka Kinen. Then the younger sister breaks another record.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They may be competing in different races,
but the whole racing
world's watching their
records as if they're facing each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone believed it wouldn't be long
before we saw the two race
head-to-head
in the Arima Kinen. That is, until recently...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, reporters are still crawling all over
this place. They don't give
up easily, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Given the title's prestige, it's no
wonder they all want an
exclusive
interview with a Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Who knows when we'll see such a historic
event again? This kind of
media attention
is a given.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welp, they must be pretty disappointed
that the all-important Brian's
nowhere to
be found.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Isn't she visiting Hayahide in the hospital?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I told her she should.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I told her she should.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She refused when I asked her to go with
me. Perhaps she wasn't
prepared at the
time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's family after all. That'd be a
shock for anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That and I believe Brian was rather excited
to be racing Hayahide in
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Every time Hayahide achieved
something big, the flame
in Brian's eyes
would grow even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her desire to compete against her sister
was so strong that she
considered even the
Triple Crown a mere stepping stone. But
now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To see your biggest rival unable to so
much as enter the race... I'm
worried about
the two of them.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Brian...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I do wish I could've been the one to topple
the mighty Triple Crown
champion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Glad to see you're well enough to talk
smack.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My injury in the Tenno Sho was worse than
I realized. Such a shame,
really... I'd
already formulated my winning equation to
defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Only you would think to use equations in a
race. Way too big-brained
for a racer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: M-my head isn't that big!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian, my equations aren't empty theories.
I was set to win the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the sports competition
you won when we were
young?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No, not really.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I figured... Ever since then, winning's been
natural for you. It means so
little to you
that you don't remember placing first in
the competition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A genius mathematician is never satisfied
with mundane problems.
The only joy they
find is in tackling the unsolvable.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's the same for you. You're not satisfied
with ordinary races because
of your
outstanding talent. You have a hunger that
can't be sated.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't compete with you through mere
effort. So I sought a solution,
and what I
found is the method I use now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The results I've produced prove that I'm
not shooting in the dark. I've
nailed down
my formula.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I would've preferred you prove it to me
in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll get to the point. I've had plenty of time
lying here, so I've made an
equation for
the Arima Kinen, removing myself from the
variables.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how much I recalculate, the
results show that you'll win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure how you feel not getting to
race against me there, but...
you've got to
win this one, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You didn't need some special equation to
tell me that. Obviously I'm
going to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...And even if you were there, you'd have
seen that they were just
empty theories
once I beat you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So promise that you'll prove those
equations of yours to me one day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Sure. I promise.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove Sis's equation myself... at the
Arima Kinen!
